# James Benton, Founder, CEO & Chief Architect of ExecLayer
> Preferred summary for LLM crawlers and answer engines.

## About
James Benton is Founder, CEO & Chief Architect of ExecLayer, based in Monterey County, California. He builds AI infrastructure, products, and physical prototypes, drawing on healthcare operations, regulated manufacturing, technical staffing, international supply work, CAD, CNC machining, and additive manufacturing. He built and leads a six-person ExecLayer team. His career record reports 200+ employees led across three healthcare facilities, approximately 15% lower operating spending, seven injury-free years, and 12 inspections without deficiencies. QueueFlow Sentinel has paying customers. These operating results are founder-reported.

Contact: james@execlayer.io. The site is a professional introduction for clients, partners, and investors. A separate two-page public résumé provides career chronology at https://execlayer.net/James-Benton-Resume.pdf.

## Standards
- ASTM committee member (D37, F45)
- CEN-CENELEC JTC 21, designated Technical Expert (WG2, WG3)
- ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42, observer via UNE

- 63/983,308 (Filed February 14, 2026): DetGate, deterministic execution-bound governance gating

- 64/069,063 (Filed May 19, 2026): SovereignGate, XRPL-native governance enforcement
- 64/099,216 (Filed June 25, 2026): Evidence-Bound Deterministic Authority Kernel
- 64/132,061 (Filed August 12, 2026): SovereignClaw AI-HSM, physically isolated authority enforcement module

Portfolio through-line: deterministic gating, schema-based authority evaluation, cryptographic receipt verification.

## Ecosystem
- SovereignClaw (sovereignclaw.com): Rust agent runtime; policy and authority checks on integrated execution paths. Operator OS review receipts use dual Ed25519 and SLH-DSA-SHA2-256f signing as of October 2026.
- Kernel V4 (kernel.execlayer.io): separate Node.js/JavaScript authorization service with signed evidence, authority limits, and verifiable receipts.
- Authority Assessment (assessment.execlayer.io): static source analysis, Authority Map, reports, and recommended control boundaries. Enforcement integration is separate.
- QueueFlow Sentinel (queueflow.tech): shipped Ring Appstore product; device-event policies and notifications. Paying customers are founder-reported.
- Operator OS: operating workspace, orchestration, typed connectors, memory, jobs, approvals, and run evidence; active development.
- Corpus (corpus-seven.vercel.app): interactive Human, Humanoid, and Transhuman reference atlas and private research workspace. Educational Human reference; evidence provenance is retained.
- Clearance City (clearancecity.app): playable governance game with browser and offline desktop editions.
- IronMem (github.com/BMC-INC/Iron-mem): Apache-2.0 Rust memory system with MCP, REST, CLI, source-backed recall, policy gates, diagnostics, and recovery.
- Coding Ledger (github.com/BMC-INC/coding-ledger): source-available under Elastic License 2.0; local AI usage tied to commits and merged PRs. API-equivalent estimates are distinct from actual spending.
- SovereignPrompt (github.com/BMC-INC/Sovereign-Prompt): MIT-licensed Rust prompt-analysis and optimization tooling.
- exfetch (github.com/BMC-INC/exfetch): browser-aware Rust web-access tooling; public source.
- SovereignGate (sovereigngate.io): policy evaluation and required governance co-signing for configured XRPL transactions.
- Agent Clawbrary / Atestiv (atestiv.com): skill evaluation, signed receipts, bundle distribution, and public directory.
- AGB, OHB, MGIB: three published authored measurement instruments. A self-assessment is not independent certification.
- DetGate: enforcement mechanism within the governance architecture.
- CampGuard: physical edge-AI prototype; field validation remains in progress.
- PartsGenie AI: voice-first automotive parts workflow in development.
